title: Explain the distinct roles of ecosystem apps
reason: Different from data portability: explains which existing ecosystem route owns a job. Advertised app overlap alone does not prove users are confused.
evidence_boundary: No missing app or feature claim; existing mToyota/Digiroom/SEVA capabilities are baseline.

title: Preserve a customer task summary into human assistance
reason: Same central mechanism as MO09: carry task context between self-service and an adviser. Keep one broad card with facets.
evidence_boundary: Do not infer current integration failure from competitor handoffs.

title: Distinguish requested, reviewed and confirmed booking states
reason: Distinct state semantics can matter even when online booking exists; current Auto2000 incidence remains unmeasured.
evidence_boundary: Deloitte general-service booking priority is low; app-review examples are not completed-job logs.

title: Show task-specific preparation before a visit
reason: Preparation documents/actions differ from appointment-state clarity or timing; one flow can expose all three.
evidence_boundary: No verified Auto2000 preparation deficit; avoid unnecessary data collection.

title: Explain coverage eligibility for the actual vehicle cohort
reason: Coverage cohort interpretation is the same core idea as MO02; C24 is a scheduled-service condition facet.
evidence_boundary: T-Care/XTRA already exist; new warranty or universal free-service claim unsupported.

title: Clarify what changes when ownership transfers
reason: Ownership-transfer conditions are a specific question distinct from general coverage or appraisal evidence.
evidence_boundary: Historical first-owner promotions do not establish current Toyota transfer restrictions.

title: Separate fleet use from private-use benefit comparisons
reason: Fleet eligibility deserves a separate actor/contract view but available support is historical campaign conditions.
evidence_boundary: No observed Auto2000 fleet mismatch, procurement pain or reachable market size.

title: Explain the meaning and limits of battery-check results
reason: Same battery-evidence/protection interpretation mechanism as MO10; keep interpretation separate from commercial appraisal acceptance.
evidence_boundary: Toyota already offers eligible health checks/certificates; no new-check novelty.

title: Connect verified ownership evidence to appraisal questions
reason: Appraiser acceptance/use of valid history or battery evidence differs from customer comprehension of a certificate.
evidence_boundary: Partner acceptance, privacy and valuation effect unknown; no resale premium.

title: Make indicative and inspected trade-in values visibly different
reason: Functionally duplicate market card: distinguish an initial indicative estimate from inspected offer.
evidence_boundary: OLXmobbi already states this; no demonstrated Auto2000 clarity deficit.

title: Clarify when transaction timing starts
reason: Start point for a payment/completion clock is distinct from price uncertainty but can sit within the same trade-in journey.
evidence_boundary: Three evidence IDs describe two partner/origin systems, not three independent success proofs.

title: Explain prequalification validity and decision authority
reason: Functionally duplicate MO08: simulation/prequalification is not lender commitment.
evidence_boundary: Existing live Auto2000 calculator and partner finance routes are baseline; not a calculator-building gap.

title: Explain household inputs needed for a finance decision
reason: A spouse-document term explains one lender-process condition, not a general household UX failure.
evidence_boundary: One source; no evidence that current Auto2000 requests are excessive or unclear.

title: Explain parts compatibility and warranty conditions together
reason: Parts compatibility and use of original parts are task-specific; coverage facet overlaps entitlement family.
evidence_boundary: Warranty terms do not prove current compatibility information is missing.

title: Compare ownership cost with service entitlements included
reason: Cost comparison including paid versus included work is a narrower facet of practical use-fit; retain facet rather than another generic calculator.
evidence_boundary: Auto2000 comparison/calculation capabilities already exist; current decision usefulness remains question.

title: Explain a paid protection extension as a separate choice
reason: A priced extension is a commercial choice, distinct from explaining existing conditional warranty continuation.
evidence_boundary: Hyundai package price is not a Toyota willingness-to-pay or dealer-margin estimate.

title: Match specialist repair needs to a suitable branch
reason: Branch capability matching is useful in principle; public locator and task-specific routes already exist.
evidence_boundary: Do not present missing branch search or recommend charging coverage from unverified geographic joins.

title: Explain emergency support by service and locality
reason: Emergency dispatch, towing, charging and service radius are separate from onward mobility.
evidence_boundary: Operator terms prove advertised scope; no current Auto2000 response failure or local availability effect.

title: Explain onward-mobility support during a qualifying repair
reason: Onward transport is a distinct service concept with real commercial dependencies.
evidence_boundary: Foreign/competitor conditional benefit does not establish Auto2000 demand or partner economics.

title: Make home-service suitability visible before choosing it
reason: THS already exists; possible scope explanation must be tied to a current observed uncertainty.
evidence_boundary: Cannot market new home-service availability or infer that all EV repairs can be done at home.

title: Explain connected-account setup and ownership changes
reason: Specific account/linking/ownership-change problems appear in self-reported app evidence; requires model/version scope.
evidence_boundary: Do not treat a competitor setup document as actual Digiroom failure, or bypass security.

title: Make connected-service renewal terms understandable
reason: A potential expiry/renewal information concept distinct from app setup.
evidence_boundary: One Hyundai contract lineage; no current Toyota equivalent or customer renewal issue established.

title: Assess multi-vehicle and multi-user needs separately
reason: Vehicle count and delegated/concurrent user access are different jobs and should not be combined as fleet feature absence.
evidence_boundary: Digiroom current review alleges a booking limit; BYD review describes feature evolution, so current universal absence is unsupported.

title: Explain service-dependent benefit continuity
reason: Scheduled-maintenance continuity is an eligibility facet of the same protection-entitlement concept.
evidence_boundary: Several warranty conditions are not independent evidence of customer misunderstanding.

title: Separate enduring benefits from expired campaign bundles
reason: Useful cross-source date/cohort distinction; do not overstate customer harm from a search-visible old release.
evidence_boundary: Two observations share one Wuling release; Chery historical offers need current contract check.

title: Make service work and price understandable
reason: Supported mechanism by general service survey and historical app/receipt account; local current gap still conditional.
evidence_boundary: Survey transparency importance is not current Auto2000 dissatisfaction or proof that more detail converts.

title: Clarify protection eligibility across lifecycle stages
reason: Same entitlement/cohort mechanism; keep distinct subquestions within a single family.
evidence_boundary: OEM terms already public; verify understanding before declaring missing protection.

title: Connect home-charging intention to practical readiness
reason: Readiness differs from generic charger search and can reveal building/utility permission rather than information failure.
evidence_boundary: Intended home charging is not no-charging access; raw SPKLU coordinates are not coverage proof.

title: Differentiate ownership information by powertrain and work due
reason: HEV/PHEV/BEV distinctions are valid technical baseline; missing current model-specific guidance not shown.
evidence_boundary: Already published OEM schedules must not be repackaged as novel app capability.

title: Preserve relationship context across ownership tasks
reason: Across-lifecycle record interpretation differs from a single adviser task summary; appraisal is one narrower use case.
evidence_boundary: No record completeness/portability inference without scoped current evidence.

title: Explain how a trade-in estimate becomes an inspected offer
reason: Same inspected-versus-indicative trade-in mechanism; merge wording and retain shared source lineage.
evidence_boundary: Understanding the estimate does not make a lower final offer attractive.

title: Compare purchase and subscription on total obligations
reason: Different commercial arrangement, not a digital feature variant; preserve as a broad optional comparison.
evidence_boundary: KINTO exists; private-use restrictions and obligations prevent universal fleet/affordability claim.

title: Distinguish credit exploration from final approval
reason: Same distinction between simulation/eligibility and final lender decision.
evidence_boundary: No approval guarantee or absent calculator claim; real affordability remains rival.

title: Support the customer’s preferred assisted route
reason: Same task-context handoff as C02; existing channels are baseline.
evidence_boundary: Stated channel preference and foreign journey studies do not demonstrate local lost context.

title: Explain battery evidence together with protection and limitations
reason: Combine with C08 for interpretation; preserve C09 as separate partner-use question.
evidence_boundary: Reports/certificates exist; condition information cannot guarantee residual value or remove price gap.

title: Frame vehicle choice around practical use trade-offs
reason: Broad household task/vehicle fit direction distinct from cost-entitlement or home-installation facets.
evidence_boundary: Narratives show both preference persistence and contextual changes; calculator output is not observed purchase impact.

title: Recognize successful quiet periods in ownership
reason: Keep as an analytical alternative to compulsory repeated opening rather than a new feature.
evidence_boundary: Quiet periods do not prove successful retention either; completion and cohort needs unavailable.

title: Compare the selected EV coverage package
reason: An insurer damage/charging package is distinct from OEM warranty or maintenance eligibility. Preserve limits/deductible/workshop terms as one scoped comparison.
evidence_boundary: EVsyariah product already exists; BEV object and optional authorized-workshop benefit do not imply automatic Auto2000 routing or demand.

title: Clarify warranty, covered damage and resale-risk boundaries
reason: Warranty defects, accidental damage and future market-value loss have different promise owners and triggers. A route explanation can expose that distinction.
evidence_boundary: No current local misunderstanding measured; no universal battery, flood or normal-degradation cover.

title: Connect an existing insurer claim to an eligible repair job
reason: Context handoff overlaps assisted continuity, but insurer repair authorization adds a distinct counterparty and eligibility boundary.
evidence_boundary: AMC/myGarda claim/repair workflows already exist; missing dealer handoff and accepted Auto2000 route unestablished.

title: Consider a plainly capped trade-in benefit
reason: Capped top-up is a limited commercial benefit, distinct from an unconditional minimum price.
evidence_boundary: May subsidize existing repeat buyers; no measured uptake, incremental delivery or viable cost envelope.

title: Investigate a full residual floor as a different obligation
reason: A full customer floor creates a different obligation from a capped benefit; do not merge their economics.
evidence_boundary: Manufacturer precedents have scope/eligibility; no Auto2000 funding or customer-effect proof.

title: Investigate a bespoke B2B risk-transfer layer
reason: B2B insurance recovery is separate from the customer floor. International availability is not a local syariah offer.
evidence_boundary: No verified Indonesian syariahRVI underwriting quote or product-specific approval; retained risks remain.

title: Treat syariah preference as a real priced choice
reason: Voluntary product choice is a different preference question from coverage explanation.
evidence_boundary: Muslim population share does not establish product selection; benefits/contribution may dominate.

title: Explain how much of a promise remains outside insurance
reason: Residual/out-of-pocket disclosure is a facet of those promises rather than an independent eighth strategy.
evidence_boundary: Preserve separate fullfloor and insurer-recovery obligations; policy limit does not limit an unconditional customer promise.
